explanation: Wife of Abraham and mother of Isaac, she dies in this chapter and her death is described.
The patriarch who makes a covenant with God and is the father of Isaac. He wishes to buy a burial place for Sara.
A Hittite who owns land at Machpelah, where Abraham wants to bury Sara.
A piece of land with a cave near Mamre, which Abraham buys from Ephron to bury Sara.
The place where Abraham buries Sara, and later he himself and his descendants are buried here.
The currency that Abraham uses to buy the burial site from Ephron.
The process in which Abraham and Ephron discuss the price of the land before agreeing on a sum.
